newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduran police station attacked with grenade.
newsitem.headline: Honduran police station attacked with grenade.

text.p: A hand grenade exploded on Wednesday at a police station in the northern Honduran city of San Pedro Sula, shattering windows and damaging cars outside but causing no injuries, police said.
A U.S.-made M-67 grenade was launched by men driving a car with tinted windows and no licence plates, they said.
It was the latest in a series of grenade or dynamite attacks on public buildings, including courtrooms, political parties and the state-owned electricity company.
The same police station in San Pedro Sula was hit in October, officials said.
No one has claimed responsibility for the attacks.
